A write carrying id equal to the declared name (the projection's id, as GET /sharing/rules lists it) stores the organization's customised copy as before. REST now plucks body.id through. (3) The reconcile. The plugin's sys_sharing_rule write trigger calls a new SharingRuleService.reconcileDeclaredRuleName for each name the write touched (the pre-image and the written row, each in its organization), BEFORE the row's own evaluateRule. Where a row holds the name, it purges the declaration's grants via ruleGrantScope(projectDeclaredRule(...)); where none does, it re-derives them via evaluateResolvedRule. A failure aborts before the copy's pass, so the two grant sets are never both in force. (4) Scopes follow the held key: under single the purge is everywhere; under a wall it covers only that organization's projection.
